overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long LITE Daily ETF (LITX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 200% leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Lumentum Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE), net of fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. LITX was launched on Jan 26, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
